definitions.explanation: A fruit with a hard reddish skin full of juicy red seeds, and the small tree that bears it.

examples.japanese: {柘榴|ざくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{柘榴|ざくろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{熟|じゅく}した→熟す：18384_jukusu⟧。

⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柘榴|ざくろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れて→割れる：00907_wareru⟧、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のぞいて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The pomegranate in the garden has split open, and the red seeds are showing inside.

notes:
Usually written ざくろ or ザクロ; the kanji {柘榴|ざくろ} (also {石榴|ざくろ}) are hard and appear mainly in literature and on menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ざくろ⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧: pomegranate juice
- ざくろ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧: pomegranate fruit

CULTURAL NOTE: A symbol of fertility; in Buddhist tradition it is the attribute of {鬼子母神|きしもじん}, the protector of children.
